subject: EU/APAC demo: timezone clash & proposed split sessions
messages:
From: Caroline Park <caroline@acme-retail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: timezone-ops@acme-retail.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:15:00 +0100
Subject: Redwood demo — trying to find a slot that fits EU + APAC

Hi Ben / Lauren,

Thanks again for the intro last week. We're eager to see Redwood's throughput and routing demos. We have a small cross-regional group (product + infra) in Europe and a couple of folks in APAC; the initial times proposed are creating a tough overlap.

Quick context: EU attendees prefer a morning slot CET/CEST; APAC prefers after 09:00 SGT (local). We noticed Dec 17 at 09:00 CET was floated — that puts APAC at 16:00 SGT, which might be OK for some but not our senior infra leads who travel that week. Also, there's a DST shift in some EU regions that week which made our calendar labels confusing.

Can you propose a few alternate options (split sessions, recordings, or a single later session) and let us know whether Redwood can run a shorter APAC-specific run?

Cheers,
Caroline
Caroline Park
Head of Product — Acme Retail
caroline@acme-retail.com

--
Attachment: product-priorities-2026Q4.pdf (ref)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Park <caroline@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — trying to find a slot that fits EU + APAC

Hi Caroline,

Really appreciate the heads-up. Short answer: yes — we can do either (A) a single later session that leans into EU/US hours and record for APAC, or (B) two short focused sessions (EU live + APAC live) with the same core demos and a short Q&A each.

Practical constraints on our side: I (Ben) have travel on Dec 17–18 (flight across the Pacific), and Lauren is traveling Dec 16–19 for AWS meeting. Stephanie can run the EU slot; I can join the APAC session on Dec 23 if we split. If you want me live for both, we'll need to pick a single time where travel and clock changes line up — that looks tight.

Proposed options from Redwood:
- Option 1: Split sessions — EU: Tue Dec 21 10:00 CET (60 min); APAC: Thu Dec 23 09:00 SGT (60 min). We’ll record both and share the recording + MAD (mutual action plan).
- Option 2: Single session — Wed Dec 22 16:00 CET / 11:00 ET (90 min) — this is late for some EU folks but would let Ben and Lauren attend before travel. APAC would watch the recording.

I've attached a 1‑page agenda and a draft mutual action plan for timing/ask alignment.

If either option works, we'll lock calendar invites and send a short pre-demo checklist for environment & network checks.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

From: Nandan Rao <nandan@acme-retail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Caroline Park <caroline@acme-retail.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 15:05:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — trying to find a slot that fits EU + APAC

Hi Ben / Caroline,

Thanks — both options look reasonable. One thing to flag: our infra leads in APAC are only available on weekdays after 09:30 SGT and are off the 22–24 window for a regional conference (we missed noting that earlier). That rules out the Dec 23 APAC slot unless we move it to the following week.

Given travel + conference constraints, could we do the EU session the week of Dec 21 and schedule APAC the week of Dec 28? We prefer not to miss Ben's live presence for APAC if possible, but a recording is acceptable in a pinch.

Also: can Redwood confirm whether the demo includes a live-run of the cross-region routing failover? We want to surface latency numbers across EU/US/APAC during the walkthrough.

Regards,
Nandan
Infrastructure Lead — Acme Retail

Hi all,

Thanks for the clarity, Nandan — that helps. Splitting and nudging APAC into the following week (Dec 28–31) is fine with us. Two quick follow-ups:

1) Live failover demo: yes — we can run a controlled cross-region routing failover and capture end-to-end latency with token-level breakdowns. We’ll bring a small dataset and a short script so it’s repeatable. That will add ~10–15 min to each session.

2) Staffing: Stephanie will lead the EU session on Tue Dec 21 10:00 CET; Ben will lead APAC the week of Dec 28 and can offer Thu Dec 30 09:30 SGT as an option. If that date conflicts for your infra leads, please propose a specific day in the Dec 28–31 window and we’ll prioritize.

I’m attaching a lightweight runbook for the failover demo (for your infra team to review) and a revised mutual action plan with dates filled in as placeholders.

Regards,
Ben

Thanks everyone — this plan works for our calendar and travel team. Final confirmations below: 

- EU session (live): Tue, 21 Dec 2026 — 10:00–11:15 CET — run by Stephanie (Redwood). Please include the failover demo and a 15‑minute Q&A. Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890
- APAC session (live): Thu, 30 Dec 2026 — 09:30–10:30 SGT — led by Ben (Redwood). If something shifts, we'll take the recording and follow up asynchronously.

Action items:
- Redwood: finalize runbook and send network checklist to timezone-ops@acme-retail.com (by EOD Wed 22 Dec).
- Acme: confirm infra attendees for APAC session by Fri 24 Dec.

Appreciate the flexibility on the split sessions — this avoids forcing a painful 02:00 start for any of our teams. Looking forward to it.

Best,
